props.title: Gaming ==Multiverse== Reasoner
props.subtitle: Every game is connected. The graph proves it.

slides.notes: Open with the hook: gaming feels like separate universes, but the data says otherwise. This project maps those connections at scale.

props.title: One giant knowledge graph of gaming.

slides.notes: Anchor the scale: this is not a toy dataset. Half a corpus of real IGDB games becomes one queryable graph.

messages.text: What connects Stardew Valley to Dark Souls?

Shortest path found — 3 hops:

Stardew Valley — built on → MonoGame
MonoGame — also powers → Celeste
Celeste — shares a tag with → Dark Souls

One engine and one infamous keyword bridge two very different worlds.

slides.notes: Read the chain out loud, hop by hop. The punchline: a cozy farming game and a punishing action RPG are three steps apart.
